caption: 💌 Do not forget to Save or tag a mama friend who needs a calm snack today 🍌💛 Why I no longer buy store-bought snacks for my toddler 🍌 These Banana Fig Soft Muffins are soft, naturally sweet, and made with real food ✅ no added sugar, gentle on toddlers, and perfect for calm snack moments. Recipe (toddler-friendly, no refined sugar): 2 ripe bananas (200g mashed) 1 egg 🥚 2 tbsp of olive oil 🫒 1/2 cup (60g) spelt flour 1/4 cup (25g) almond  1 tsp baking powder 1/4 tsp cinnamon  3 figs (soaked & finely chopped) for the topping. Mix → bake 180°C / 350°F for 18–20 min until soft & golden.  Perfect for breakfast or calm snack moments 🌿 #toddlerapproved #sugarfreesnacks #healthysnacksideas #blwinspiration #babyfood
